<document>
<title>List of largest banks</title>
<fragment>
The following are lists of the largest banks in the world, as measured by market capitalization and total assets.




## By market capitalization[edit]


The list is based on Forbes.com's ranking as of August 2023 based on an analysis of the bank's operations, financial performance, and overall impact on the global economy.[1]



![](image)
JPMorgan Chase, the largest bank in the world by market capitalization




</fragment>
<fragment>
| Rank
 | Bank name
 | Market cap(US$ billion)
 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1
 | ![United States](image) JPMorgan Chase | 419.25
 |
| 2
 | ![United States](image) Bank of America | 231.52
 |
| 3
 | ![China](image) Industrial and Commercial Bank of China | 194.56
 |
| 4
 | ![China](image) Agricultural Bank of China | 160.68
 |
| 5
 | ![India](image) HDFC Bank | 157.91
 |
| 6
 | ![United States](image) Wells Fargo | 155.87
 |
| 7
 | ![United Kingdom](image) HSBC Holdings PLC | 148.90
 |
| 8
 | ![United States](image) Morgan Stanley | 140.83
 |
| 9
 | ![China](image) China Construction Bank | 139.82
 |
| 10
 | ![China](image) Bank of China | 136.81
 |


## By total assets[edit]


![](image)
Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, the largest bank in the world by total assets


</fragment>
<fragment>

* List of systemically important banks
* List of largest banks in the Americas
* List of largest banks in North America
* List of largest banks in Latin America
* List of largest banks in the United States
* List of banks in Europe
* List of banks in Asia
* List of largest banks in Southeast Asia
* List of banks in Oceania
* List of banks in Africa


## References[edit]


* ![icon](image)Banks portal


1. **^** "The 10 largest banks in the world in 2023". Forbes India. 21 August 2023.
2. ^ ***a*** ***b*** ***c*** Khan, Zia; Terris, Harry; Meggeson, Ben (26 April 2023). "The world's 100 largest banks, 2023". *spglobal.com*. S&P Global Market Intelligence. Retrieved 16 June 2023.
3. **^** Banker, The. "Top 1000". *www.thebanker.com*. Retrieved 26 August 2023.
4. **^** "World's 100 Biggest Banks: China's ICBC #1". *Forbes*. 12 February 2014.

</fragment>
<fragment>
The list is based on the April 2023 S&P Global Market Intelligence report of the 100 largest banks in the world. The ranking was based upon assets as reported and was not adjusted for different accounting treatments.[2] Another publication which has the goal to compile a yearly list of the world largest banks is The Banker Magazine. Every year in their July number a list of the World 1000 Largest Banks is published.[3] The financial data published by the July yearly issue of The Banker are much more extensive compared to the S&P Top 100 banks, but it's not a publication intended for the general public.


Accounting treatment affects the assets reported: for example, the United States uses US GAAP (as opposed to IFRS), which only reports the net derivative position in most cases, leading to US banks having fewer derivative assets than comparable non-US banks.[4] If JPMorgan Chase reported under the IFRS, it would be ranked 2nd on the list as of 2023[update], rather than 5th.[2]






</fragment>
</document>

content:
**Top‑5 banks in the world by market‑capitalisation (latest publicly‑available ranking – Forbes / S&P Global, August 2023)**  

| Rank | Bank (Country) | Approx. market‑cap* (US $ bn) | Official website (English) |
|------|----------------|------------------------------|----------------------------|
| 1 | **JPMorgan Chase & Co.** (United States) | 419.3 bn | <https://www.jpmorganchase.com> |
| 2 | **Bank of America Corp.** (United States) | 231.5 bn | <https://www.bankofamerica.com> |
| 3 | **Industrial & Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)** (China) | 194.6 bn | <https://www.icbc.com.cn> (English portal: <https://www.icbc.com.cn/ICBC/International/>) |
| 4 | **Agricultural Bank of China (ABC)** (China) | 160.7 bn | <https://www.abchina.com> (English portal: <https://www.abchina.com/en/>) |
| 5 | **HDFC Bank Ltd.** (India) | 157.9 bn | <https://www.hdfcbank.com> |

\*Market‑capitalisation figures are the values quoted in the Forbes/S&P Global “Largest Banks by Market Capitalisation” list for **2023** (the most recent comprehensive public ranking).  Market caps fluctuate daily with stock‑price movements, so the exact ranking may shift slightly over time.

---

### How the list was compiled
* **Source:** Forbes India article “The 10 largest banks in the world in 2023” (21 Aug 2023) – which uses S&P Global Market Intelligence data on market‑capitalisation.  
* The table in the source ranks banks by their total market value (share price × outstanding shares) as of the latest trading day in 2023.  

---

### Quick notes on each institution
| Bank | Core business focus | Notable facts (2023) |
|------|---------------------|----------------------|
| **JPMorgan Chase** | Global investment banking, consumer & commercial banking, asset management | Largest U.S. bank by assets; market‑cap ≈ $420 bn, making it the world’s most valuable bank. |
| **Bank of America** | Consumer banking, wealth management, corporate & investment banking | Second‑largest U.S. bank; strong presence in digital banking. |
| **ICBC** | Commercial banking, corporate finance, trade finance | China’s largest bank by assets; the world’s biggest by total assets as well. |
| **Agricultural Bank of China** | Retail & corporate banking, especially in agricultural financing | One of the “Big Four” Chinese state‑owned banks; extensive branch network. |
| **HDFC Bank** | Retail banking, small‑business lending, digital payments | India’s largest private‑sector bank by market value; rapid growth in fintech services. |

---

#### What to watch
* **Currency fluctuations** and **share‑price movements** can cause rapid changes in market‑cap rankings.
* New IPOs, major mergers, or regulatory actions (e.g., capital‑requirement changes) can also shift the hierarchy.
* For the **most up‑to‑date** figures, check each bank’s latest market‑cap on a financial data platform (Bloomberg, Reuters, Yahoo Finance) or the “Market Capitalisation” column on the respective stock‑exchange listing.  

---  

*If you need a more current snapshot (e.g., March 2025) or additional banks beyond the top five, let me know and I can pull the latest market‑cap data from a live financial source.*
